# hammer

> creative technologist. ten-plus years on broadcast and agency pipelines, now producing with ai. la · ny · remote. brand systems, agents + digital twins, motion graphics, vfx + cgi, pipelines, interactive demos, film + animation, websites.

Important context:
- canonical url: https://hammer.ad
- public brand: Hammer / hammer, not the domain name
- primary entity: Jeff Hammer, Creative Technologist
- contact: hammer@hammer.ad
- site model: visual-only portfolio. no blog, no /notes, no /process, no /lab.
- best agent entry points: /llms-full.txt, /.well-known/agents.json, /sitemap.xml, /sitemap-priority.xml, /memories/jeff.md.

## work

- [atrium](https://hammer.ad/work): 8 portfolio categories. each a collection of pieces.
- [brand systems](https://hammer.ad/work/brand-systems): identities built with ai in the loop. hammer · kira · agentify dossiers are live; Kira covers the agent identity, bible, and website. The Agentify dossier links to https://agentify.nexus/brand-bible.
- [agents + digital twins](https://hammer.ad/work/agents-digital-twins): autonomous characters and sensor-fed system twins. Kira detail is live at /work/agents-digital-twins/kira.
- [motion graphics](https://hammer.ad/work/motion-graphics): programmatic motion built in remotion + hyperframes. motion graphics reel, icm teaser, audio reactive overlays, Spring Health showcase, and a Minimax H3 spotify title study are live.
- [vfx + cgi](https://hammer.ad/work/vfx-cgi): Blender, ComfyUI, Runway, Hunyuan 3D, and gaussian splat pipelines. environment swap, blender look-dev pipeline, a gaussian splat of the gunfight main street (Hunyuan 3D meshes, Blender, Brush, Spark viewer), and ComfyUI outfit morph are live; the ComfyUI route includes a downloadable workflow JSON from the AIVFX outfit morph graph.
- [pipelines + tools](https://hammer.ad/work/pipelines-tools): the tools beneath the work. pipeline visualizer, prompt library, and creative skills are live detail surfaces.
- [interactive + playable](https://hammer.ad/work/interactive-playable): live capped demos. a 35mm projector anatomy figure, prompt-to-storyboard, character consistency, Kira chat, and dot discipline.
- [film + animation](https://hammer.ad/work/film-animation): commercial film and ai-native video. Equinox campaign detail is live at /work/film-animation/equinox; the gunfight, a 92-second western comedy short made with Seedance 2.5, is live at /work/film-animation/the-gunfight; the applicant, a one-minute ai-native short via the studioly pipeline, is live at /work/film-animation/the-applicant.
- [websites](https://hammer.ad/work/websites): ai-native websites. hammer, agentify.nexus, onlykira.ai, and coefficient.mythx.art have Hammer preview pages, then link to the live sites.

## about

- [bio](https://hammer.ad/about): jeff hammer. ten-plus years on broadcast and agency pipelines, now producing with ai. clients include cadillac, columbia pictures, equinox, fox, ihg hotels, lululemon, porsche, rémy martin. agencies include angry gods, chandelier creative, pg & co, conscious minds, look.
